youtube_title: Scratching A Mosquito Bite? It Makes It Worse | Body Fix #46 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #46. Mosquito bite, and you've scratched it RED already?
B is right. Cold compress, DON'T scratch. Scratching = more itch + infection risk.
The itch is your body reacting to its saliva. Scratching breaks skin, germs get in.
Fix: Cold compress 10 MIN, wash with soap, short nails, repellent and nets.
Red flags: Fever, body ache, rash, or a hot swollen bite with pus? See a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: NHS - Insect bites
